messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock API surface + SDK/docs work for next milestone. Customers pushing for: reliable function/tool calling, structured output types, and clear changelog/upgrade notes. Proposing minimal v1 scope and what can slip to v1.1. Thoughts?

maria: +1 we should make function calling contract explicit in both Python/TS (types). otherwise users will diverge.

jonathan: Agree. Suggested priority: 1) stable API for chat/completions 2) typed function_call schema 3) structured output examples 4) embeddings unchanged 5) rerank as opt-in beta.

alex: Proposed launch checklist items: docs page, 2 end-to-end examples (py/ts), type defs, changelog entry + migration guide, deprecation warnings in client. If any of those missing -> hold GA.

Tess: For the typed function_call, do we want this shape?
```
function_call: {
  name: string,
  arguments: Record<string, unknown> // prefer typed interfaces
}
```
We should show both untyped and typed examples.

maria: +1. For TS we should offer generated types from the model manifest. For Python, dataclasses/pydantic models. Example snippet in docs:
```ts
// TS example
const res = await client.chat.create({
  messages, 
  function_call: {name: 'lookup', schema: MyLookupSchema}
})
```

jonathan: Timeline constraint: eng-runtime needs the kernel/fallback changes locked by EOD next Wed to support the structured output hooks. Otherwise we can't guarantee backward-compatible behavior. Do we have capacity?

alex: Eng-runtime ok but only if we limit the scope of schema enforcement (server returns raw tokens + metadata). Client will parse and validate. So runtime change is small (add metadata envelope).

Tess: Docs tasks: 1) API spec update (openapi + human prose) 2) 2 quickstarts (py/ts) 3) migration guide from old function_call usage 4) examples repo PRs. I can own API spec + examples if devs can review.

maria: I'll draft TS types and the changelog section. Can someone take Python typing + pydantic models?

alex: I can take Python models and a short migration guide. Plan: ship alpha docs + examples behind feature-flag (opt-in) in two weeks, GA after internal beta & a cusp customer sign-off (~4 weeks).

jonathan: Risk: rerank API surface still unclear. Recommend we mark rerank as "preview" and only publish examples, not SDK helpers.

Tess: Agreed. Keep rerank out of mandatory launch checklist.

sam-bot: NOTE: created jira RED-1423 "SDK: function_call typed surface + docs" and assigned to @maria/@alex/@tess, due 2026-04-08.

alex: Next steps: maria + alex + tess sync today 3pm PT. jonathan will share runtime envelope PR by EOD Tue. We'll move forward if runtime PR lands. If not, we defer structured output enforcement to v1.1. @maria @tess @jonathan

maria: 3pm works for me. I'll start TS typedef draft now.

jonathan: I'll post the minimal envelope patch link in the thread after I open the PR.

Tess: I'll stub the examples repo and open PR for review post-sync.

alex: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
